items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: I take a couple of clarinet lessons from Steve Anger.

ctx.x: No no. He told us about his dad's set. We just interviewed him a couple months ago.

He told all about it but he never saved any of that I don't think. Well I couldn't tell you who might have one. But anyway at that time we had a cymbal down on the bass drum. Oh yeah. I've heard. I've seen that. When you hit the bass drum you hit. You play a cymbal and a bass drum. Yeah. In other words you didn't get just a boom. Sound you got to chum. Something like that. Chum. That's what you got. And we only had one cymbal hanging up there. That cymbal used to hang. We used to call that. Well I had a Chinese…
